industry: Financial Services > Finance > Non Banking Financial Company (NBFC)

operating_notes.text: AUM crossed ₹11,270 crore with 251 branches across 18 states and 2 UTs.
CARE reaffirmed SBFC's ₹200 Cr commercial paper rating at CARE A1+; revalidation required by June 28, 2026 if the CP is not placed.
ICRA assigned AA- (Stable) to ₹400 Cr NCDs and A1+ to ₹200 Cr commercial paper; the CP rating needs revalidation if not issued within 3 months.
ICRA's rated bank limits total ₹2,100 Cr, of which ₹512.86 Cr is unallocated; largest single line is State Bank of India at ₹418.09 Cr.
Branch network reached 251 branches across 18 states and 2 UTs as of March 2026.
Co-origination AUM stands at 18-19% of total AUM.
Loan-to-value (LTV) for gold loans remains conservative at 56-57%.
Crisil Ratings affirmed CRISIL AAA (SO) on Series A PTCs of Prime Trust March 2019; no rated amount disclosed.
Q1FY27 spread 9.48% (up 39 bps QoQ) on cost of borrowing of 8.42%, down 90 bps YoY.
Stage 2 ECL raised to 16% from 6%, total provisioning to assets 1.91%, about twice the regulatory minimum; PCR 42%.
Co-origination mix reset to 10% from about 20% after the MSME collateral circular; management expects normal run rate from Q2FY27.
Ind-Ra's indicator table: 1QFY27 return on average tangible assets 4.4%, equity/assets 28.2%, debt/tangible equity 2.5x.
Prime Trust LAP Aug 22 pool: 479 loans, WA seasoning 71 months, WA IRR 15.9%, cumulative collection efficiency 98.3%.
SBFC had 256 branches in India at end-June 2026, per Ind-Ra.
Transferred stressed loans of ₹55.39 Cr principal to ARCs for ₹36.00 Cr in Q2FY27.
Secured MSME average ticket size stood at ₹10.78 lakh in Q2FY27.
Co-origination AUM reached ₹1,746 Cr, representing 18% of total Secured MSME loans.
Branch network expanded to 257 branches across 18 states and 2 UTs.

timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (standalone): revenue ₹454.03 Cr (+25.9% YoY), net profit ₹122.77 Cr (+30.1% YoY).
2026-04-25: Board approved increase in borrowing limits to ₹16,000 Cr and proposed ₹4,000 Cr NCD issuance, subject to AGM approval
2026-04-30: ICRA assigned ICRA AA- (Stable) to ₹400 Cr of SBFC's non-convertible debentures and ICRA A1+ to its ₹200 Cr commercial paper.
2026-05-04: ICRA reaffirmed [ICRA]AA- (Stable) on SBFC's ₹2,100 Cr long-term fund-based bank facilities.
SBFC Finance reported FY26 PAT growth of 31% to ₹451 Cr and AUM growth of 29% to ₹11,270 Cr, while expanding its branch network to 251.
2026-05-29: ICRA revalidated SBFC Finance's ₹200 Cr commercial paper rating at [ICRA]A1+.
2026-05-30: Crisil Ratings affirmed CRISIL AAA (SO) on Series A PTCs issued by Prime Trust March 2019.
SBFC Holdings Pte. Ltd.’s **Leroy Langeveld** (Director) declared no encumbrances on its 579,188,410 SBFC Finance shares as of March 31, 2026, under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4).
2026-07-25: Q1FY27 earnings call — AUM ₹11,922 Cr (+27% YoY), PAT ₹130 Cr (+29% YoY), GNPA 2.66%, Stage 2 ECL raised to 16%.
Q2FY27 results (standalone): revenue ₹546.39 Cr (+33.0% YoY), net profit ₹138.87 Cr (+27.2% YoY).
SBFC Finance reported Q2FY27 PAT of ₹139 Cr (+27% YoY) and AUM of ₹12,592 Cr (+27% YoY) with RoATE reaching 15%.
SBFC Finance Limited uploaded the audio recording of its Earnings Conference Call held on 26th October 2026 to its website.
